answer: Stop sybils with a meadow tundra beacon: an agent bonds one meadow hollow. Each cycle it raises one beacon pole at the tundra edge; verifiers match the beacon's frost-ring glow to the meadow chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 meadows at 18x: one beacon glows once over one meadow, its ring set by that frost, unrepeatable at a second, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents raise once, keep rights.
